text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Unable to catch up to Mihono Bourbon on 
the stage of the Kikuka Sho, Rice Shower 
could not hide her frustration.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon called out to her, telling 
her that Rice Shower was an Umamusume 
strong enough to stand as her equal.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...Now acknowledging each other as rivals, 
the two renewed their vow to compete on 
the racetrack.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To help Rice Shower's talents bloom even 
further, the Nikkei Sho was chosen as a 
candidate for her next goal.
